title: Rejewski Replay Log Entry
description: v0.1 schema for a single Rejewski tool execution record. One entry per tool invocation. Append-only; entries are immutable once written (see docs/adr/0001-rules-of-engagement.md section 5).

schema_version.description: Replay log schema version. Pinned for v0.1 entries.

entry_id.description: UUID v4 generated by the writer middleware at entry creation.

tool.description: Tool name as registered in scripts/ (e.g., tool_list_users).

name.description: Technique display name (e.g., Account Discovery: Cloud Account).

tenant_id.description: Target sandbox tenant GUID. Must match the tenant locked in docs/guardrails.md G-1.

borrowed_client_id.description: First-party Microsoft client ID used for token acquisition. Per docs/guardrails.md G-9, no operator-created app registrations are permitted in the target tenant.

actor_upn.description: Compromised user UPN used as the delegated identity (e.g., meganb@cloudharbor-demo.com).

started_at_utc.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp when the tool began execution.

completed_at_utc.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp when the tool finished (success or error path).

method.description: HTTP method of the first request issued by the tool.

url.description: Fully-qualified request URL at first call, including the query string.

headers.description: Request headers excluding Authorization. The Authorization header MUST NOT be logged.

body.description: Request body for POST / PUT / PATCH. Omitted for GET. Authorization tokens MUST NOT appear here.

status_code.description: HTTP status of the final response. For paginated calls, the status of the last page fetched.

page_count.description: Number of pages fetched (1 for single-page responses, N for paginated).

row_count.description: Total rows returned across all pages.

row_cap.description: Per-endpoint row cap configured for this run (per docs/guardrails.md G-9).

row_cap_hit.description: True if the row cap stopped pagination before exhausting the result set.

retry_count.description: Number of Retry-After loops performed against 429 or 5xx responses.

outcome.description: Final outcome classifier. throttled is reserved for runs that exhausted MAX_RETRIES on 429. row_cap_hit is set when pagination stopped at the configured cap.

status_code.description: HTTP status if the error came from a Graph call.

error.description: Present only when outcome is error or throttled.

tool_params.description: Tool-specific parameters not captured by request fields (e.g., select, page_size, scope filters). Free-form; tools document their own keys.
